selection: Rank threshold-qualified RFUs by number of donors with >=10 cells, then donors with >=5 cells, then total cells, then literal RFU label; take the first three. Metadata only; no expression or UMAP-based selection.

logo.weight: one per distinct CDR3 amino-acid string
logo.length: modal unique-sequence length within each RFU, shorter length breaks ties

contrast.population: All source-annotated Wells cells with a threshold-qualified primary-TRB assignment
contrast.selection: SHA256(seed|group|cell_id) ordering; min(case, background) without replacement within each exact stratum
contrast.expression: raw/X; require nonnegative, finite, integer-valued stored counts
contrast.normalization: Sum selected cells within donor/group; CPM using all raw genes; log2(CPM+1)
contrast.test: Two-sided paired t-test across donors, equal donor weights; no cell-level replication
contrast.gene_filter: CPM >=1 in at least N of 2N pseudobulks, positive variance of paired differences, source feature_is_filtered false; exclude TCR genes matching ^TR[ABDG][VDJC]
contrast.adjustment: Benjamini-Hochberg over all tested genes; q<0.05
contrast.effect: Mean within-donor difference in log2(CPM+1), case minus matched background
contrast.scope: Exploratory donor-paired inference with small pseudobulks, observational RFU membership, residual state/clone confounding; not radiotherapy DE or a mechanistic result.
